errorCodes.meaning: `data` decodes to more than 262144 bytes, or to a picture larger than the community decodes — more pixels, or more memory to decode, than its bound. Nothing was stored.
`data` does not decode as an image of `mediaType`, or as an image the community can re-encode. Nothing was stored.
The signer has sent as many logos as the community allows in its current window. Nothing was stored.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

LogoImage.description: An image as the administrator sends it.

data.description: The image, base64url without padding (RFC 4648 §5). At most 262144 bytes decoded.

mediaType.description: The media type of `data` as sent. The community decodes `data` as this type only, and may store another: it re-encodes.

LogoImage.title: LogoImage

LogoMediaType.description: The raster media types a logo may be sent and stored as. No vector format: an SVG is a document that can carry script and fetch resources, so a client rasterizes one before sending it.
LogoMediaType.title: LogoMediaType

LogoRef.description: The logo as the community stores it: its own re-encoding, never the bytes it received.

height.description: The stored image's height in pixels.

mediaType.description: The media type of the stored bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored, re-encoded bytes.

size.description: The length of the stored bytes.

width.description: The stored image's width in pixels.

LogoRef.title: LogoRef

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/community/logo/update/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/community/logo/update/0.1#response.

logo.description: The logo the community now holds, or `null` when it holds none.

stored.description: True when this request changed the stored logo; false when it equals the one already stored, or removed a logo the community did not hold.

updatedAt.description: When the stored logo was last replaced or removed. Absent when the community has never held one.

Response.title: VTC Community — Logo — Update — response payload

schema.description: The community's new logo, which the community re-encodes and stores in place of the one it holds — or `null` to remove it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

image.description: The new logo as sent, or `null` to remove the stored one. Removing is an explicit `null`, never an omitted member.
